title: DiscordSRV Slash Commands
description: This Plugin adds multiple Slash Commands to Discord with a completely customizable config. It adds all vanilla commands and a bunch of additional nice features.
body:
# DiscordSRV-Slash-Commands This Plugin adds multiple Slash Commands to Discord with a completely customizable config. It adds all vanilla commands and a bunch of additional nice features. ## Content - [How to use](#how-to-use) - [Config Setup](#config-setup) - [All added Commands](#a-list-of-all-added-commands) - [Development Progress](#development-progress) - [Release Timeline](#release-timeline)


## How to use ## Config Setup The Config consists of two sections: **Commands:** Here you activate specific commands or command-groups. If a command-group is disabled all commands in that group are disabled. **Command Overrides:** In this section you override specific command permissions to fit your individual needs.Depending on the override-type it either adds the role to the command permissions, or replaces the default permissions by the override Example: `playerlist-override: [everyone]` allows everyone to use the playerlist command


## A list of all added Commands: - /advancement - /attribute - /ban - /ban-ip - /banlist - /bossbar - /clear - /clone - /damage - /data - /datapack - /debug - /defaultgamemode - /deop - /difficulty - /effect - /enchant - /execute - /experience - /fill - /fillbiome - /forceload - /function - /gamemode - /gamerule - /give - /help - /item - /jfr - /kick - /kill - /list - /locate - /loot - /op - /pardon - /pardon-ip - /particle - /perf - /place - /playsound - /publish - /random - /recipe - /reload - /return - /ride - /save-all - /save-off - /save-on - /say - /schedule - /scoreboard - /seed - /setblock - /setidletimeout - /setworldspawn - /spawnpoint - /spreadplayers - /stop - /stopsound - /summon - /tag - /team - /teleport - /time - /tick - /title - /tp - /weather - /whitelist - /worldborder - /xp
